text:
nina: quick alert — canary rollout v2.6.3 showing p95 drift in ap-south, started ~7m ago :triangular_flag_on_post:
deploy-bot: rollout: v2.6.3 -> 25% ap-south. metrics: p95=780ms (baseline 340ms), errors=0.1%. autorevert rule p95>700ms sustained 5m.
sam: dashboard confirms trend across two nodes, not a single runaway pod
infra-kate: no infra config changed in the PR; could be model side. can we pin traffic and triage?
nina: pinning traffic to 25% and applying manual hold now. deploy-bot: manual hold applied by nina; autopilot suppressed.
sre-lee: propose targeted restart + heap/proc snapshots on the two worst pods; if no improvement, rollback to v2.6.2 (build 20260405.4).
pm-elaine: if rollback happens please prepare release-note line and a short customer blurb. ops should draft concurrent watch.
sam: triggered restarts on node-a03 and a04. will post metrics in 90s.
sre-lee: after restart node-a04 p95 dropped to 360ms, node-a03 to 400ms, cluster p95 420ms — looks resolved.
nina: good. keep manual hold for 15m. rollback threshold: sustained >650ms for 6m triggers rollback to v2.6.2.
pm-elaine: customer blurb queued: "Canary paused for v2.6.3 due to increased latency; investigating. No user-facing errors observed." send after ops thumbs up.
infra-kate: logging action: reason=canary-p95-drift, action=manual-hold+pod-restart, rollback-if=6m sustained >650ms, rollback-target=v2.6.2
nina: thanks team — will update if anything changes :hourglass:
